regime.method: IHSG daily return + 20-session annualized volatility + KOMPAS100 daily breadth
regime.note: Model is refit in GitHub Actions; state labels are assigned by fitted mean daily return. Probabilities are model estimates, not guaranteed forecasts.

method.quality: not scored: reliable point-in-time quality fundamentals are not currently available in the existing data feed
method.trend_persistence: fraction of available 1/3/6/12-month horizons with positive return; 12-month variant excludes most recent month where history permits
method.value: existing monthly Value Gap transformed with signed log then ranked; not a standalone valuation conclusion
method.liquidity: latest volume divided by median of prior 20 sessions
method.low_volatility: inverse annualized standard deviation of daily close-to-close returns
method.mean_reversion: OU-style half-life estimated on log(close/SMA20), screening range 2-30 sessions
method.backtest: next-session entry, 5/20-session exit; 0.30% assumed round-trip costs; overlapping pooled observations; not portfolio simulation

signals.name: Multi-Factor Alpha
signals.description: Cross-sectional ranking across available Momentum, Trend Persistence, Relative Strength, Value Gap, Liquidity, and Low Volatility. Quality is deliberately not imputed without reliable point-in-time fundamentals.

signals.name: Trend Persistence & Momentum Quality
signals.description: Checks 1/3/6/12-month return consistency and a momentum variant excluding the latest month.

signals.name: Market Regime & Adaptive Signals
signals.description: Uses the existing HMM market regime probabilities as context. It does not independently issue buy/sell orders.

signals.name: Cross-Sectional Relative Strength
signals.description: Existing percentile-style SPC relative strength ranking and sector/IHSG excess return.

signals.name: Breadth & Sector Rotation
signals.description: Uses existing sector rotation and technical signal universe as context; a full historical breadth series is not inferred if unavailable.

signals.name: Volatility-Adjusted Risk & Position Sizing
signals.description: Displays annualized realized volatility, an absolute-return ATR proxy, and risk flags. Position size is a scenario estimate, not a personalized allocation.

signals.name: Mean Reversion & OU Half-Life
signals.description: OU-style estimate on log(close/SMA20), with half-life limited to 2–30 sessions; R² is diagnostic only and not a stationarity test.

signals.name: Signal Validation & Walk-Forward Lab
signals.description: Rolling historical momentum proxy with next-session entry, 5/20-session exit, assumed costs, and a market-universe baseline. Not yet a full portfolio-level walk-forward engine.

results.note: Exploratory pooled historical observations; overlapping trades and cross-sectional dependence mean this is not a final portfolio backtest.
